title: Flick core: modules, event bus, control socket
Quality gates: Rust check:all (fmt, clippy pedantic subset, test, custom checks) + CI + pre-commit
description:
Port the os-eco check:all standard (~/Projects/os-eco/docs/check-all-standard.md, template ~/Projects/os-eco/templates/l5-toolkit/) to Rust.

Runner: scripts/check-all.sh with the same contract as check-all.ts: gates run in a fixed order; each prints one ✓/✗ line with its time; on failure it prints only lines matching error/warning/FAILED/panicked/budget (or the last 25 lines) plus a re-run hint; --bail; CHECK_ALL_VERBOSE=1.

Gates, in order:
1. lint: cargo fmt --check (rustfmt.toml max_width=100) + cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -D warnings. Lints go in Cargo.toml [lints]: clippy all=deny, pedantic=warn, plus unwrap_used, expect_used, panic, todo, dbg_macro, undocumented_unsafe_blocks, multiple_unsafe_ops_per_block, allow_attributes_without_reason, too_many_lines, cognitive_complexity (clippy.toml threshold 15). Relax the FFI-noisy pedantic lints. Existing violations use #[expect(..., reason)].
2. check:layers: unsafe/objc2/CF only under src/platform; src/core imports no platform; modules never import each other. Grep script, rules in scripts/layer-rules.toml, every allow entry has a why. Starts as a no-op until flick-ee5b lands.
3. check:agents: backticked paths and commands in AGENTS.md must exist (port of validate-agents-md.ts).
4. check:deps: cargo machete + cargo deny check (advisories, licenses, sources).
5. check:size: file-size ratchet, 500 lines, src/**/*.rs + tests; budgets in scripts/file-size-budgets.json; stale entries fail.
6. check:debt: TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX must cite flick-xxxx, #N or a URL; path:line allowlist; stale entries fail.
7. check:binary-size: release binary ratchet (start at 5 MB).
8. check:coverage: cargo llvm-cov over the pure modules (core/, config, store, search) with an up-only floor in scripts/coverage-budgets.json.
9. check:ci-parity: CI runs scripts/check-all.sh only, so parity holds by construction; the script only asserts that.

Skip jscpd (it is a Node tool and the codebase is small); revisit later.
Hooks: scripts/hooks/pre-commit runs the full check-all.sh (warren policy: if a check is too slow for the hook, fix the check), with GIT_* env vars unset. Install it with scripts/setup.sh (git config core.hooksPath scripts/hooks).
Every ratchet budget only moves one way, and the scripts never edit their own budgets.

title: herdr module: monitor agents across machines and jump to them
description: v1 only monitors and jumps (roots r-5052); no replies, no chat UI. Thin client over herdr's socket API (herdr api schema/snapshot; agent list/read/wait; --machine); never implement SSH/transport in Flick. Shows agents on all machines, waiting-on-me first, with a preview of recent output; activating one focuses its herdr pane. Optional notification when an agent starts to wait. Prefer an event stream from herdr over polling (check api schema first). Replies are a later, separate seed, and only if they are easy.

title: Activity module: event-driven app/window/idle tracking (replaces Rize)
description: Privacy first (roots r-5f73). Recording is easy to turn on and off: a launcher command, an optional hotkey, and a visible indicator while it records. Data stays on this machine until I give explicit permission for a remote use. Spans are written to SQLite on Event::AppActivated + AX window-title change + idle threshold (CGEventSourceSecondsSinceLastEventType); no polling loop. Categorization uses config rules (app/title regex -> project/category). A small local model for what the rules miss comes later. CLI: flick activity today|week [--json]. Browser URLs deferred (they need per-browser AppleScript).

title: Create Quicklink from the launcher UI (Raycast-style form)
description:
Add/edit/delete quicklinks without hand-editing config.toml, like Raycast's 'Create Quicklink'.

- Builtin item 'Create Quicklink' opens a form view: name, URL/path (with {query} placeholder), optional keyword, optional app to open with. Tab between fields; Enter saves; Esc cancels.
- From a quicklink item: actions to Edit and Delete.
- Persist by appending/updating [[quicklink.links]] in config.toml (preserve comments/formatting, e.g. toml_edit), then reload. Write the new table form, not legacy [[quicklinks]] (see flick-c3c1).
- Validate: unique name (see flick-abe2 duplicate-name bug), non-empty URL, keyword not clashing.
- Needs a form/text-field ListView kind in core + panel support; keep it generic so other modules can reuse it.
- CLI parity: flick quicklink add <name> <url> [--keyword k].

title: Rebuild / reinstall Flick from the launcher (from the local checkout)
description:
Let the user install the latest local code from inside Flick, instead of asking an agent to run scripts/bundle.sh --install.

Source of truth is the LOCAL checkout, not origin. Agents commit locally, and those commits are often ahead of GitHub. A git pull would miss that work, or conflict with it. No git network operations.

- 'Rebuild Flick': build from the checkout's current HEAD, reinstall, relaunch. 'Rebuild Flick (dirty)' or a modifier key: build the working tree as it is, uncommitted changes included, and mark the version '-dirty'.
- 'Flick Version' / launcher subtitle: installed commit + build time, and whether the checkout is ahead ('3 commits newer in ~/Projects/flick: <subjects>'). Bake the commit sha into the binary at build time.
- Checkout path: [flick] source = "~/Projects/flick" in config, defaulting to the path baked in at build time.
- Optional: on LauncherOpened/Wake, compare the installed sha to the checkout HEAD with local git only. If they differ, show a 'Rebuild available' item. Never rebuild automatically.
- Run the build on a background thread with progress in the panel ('Building… 42s'). Post the result to the main thread via the event channel. Log output to a file and open the log on failure.
- Never leave a half-installed app: build into target/, run gates or at least cargo build first, and swap the bundle only on success.
- Relaunch through a detached helper, or launchd, which bundle.sh already uses, so the old process can quit. Keep the single-instance check working across the swap.
- Optional: build a different branch or worktree, for example to try an agent's worktree before merging.
- CLI parity: flick flick rebuild [--dirty] | version.

activity: record the active tab URL for Brave (and other Chromium browsers/Safari) per span
description: Today a span stores app, bundle id and (opt-in, [activity] titles) the window title. No URLs. Add an opt-in [activity] urls switch: on a focus/title change in a known browser, read the front tab URL (Chromium AppleScript 'URL of active tab of front window'; Safari 'URL of front document'; needs Automation permission per browser, osascript/NSAppleScript in src/platform). Store on the span (new append-only migration), report top domains, and gate remote (bridge) access the same way as titles in the activity remote grant (flick-eed3). Respect exclude rules; never read URLs from private/incognito windows.

herdr: Show Output is bound to ⌘K (opens the actions menu) and the output view splits the agent's reply into one row per line
description: Feedback 2026-10-09T12:38:23-07:00. Footer of herdr 'agents' view advertises '⌘K Show Output' (src/modules/herdr/mod.rs:313) but ⌘K opens the actions menu, where Show Output is one action. Give it its own key (see flick-f4cb, Tab action) and fix the footer. The 'agent' view renders output as herdr:line/<n> rows (views.rs:170); show the agent's last response as one block of text (wrapped, copyable) instead.

title: feedback: multi-line text input for Add Feedback (field is one line and scrolls)
description: Feedback 2026-10-09T12:38:39-07:00. Add Feedback form uses a one-line NSTextField (platform/panel/form.rs). Add a multi-line Field kind (wrapping, taller, ⌘↵ submits, ↵ inserts newline or submits by choice) and use it for feedback text.

title: Per-feature help: in-launcher help/tutorial for each module (e.g. draw tools: colors 1-5, erase, text, redact)
description: Feedback 2026-10-09T12:39:23-07:00: 'idk how the draw works, can I switch colors? Erase? Or just red?' Ink editor keys exist (platform/ink/model.rs:295: pen/highlight/text/redact, 1-5 colors, Delete clears, cmd+z) but are not discoverable. Add an on-screen key legend in the ink overlay and a Help item/view per module (could read docs/*.md).

title: tasks: launcher view listing all tasks (not just pick/today); manage done/rename/delete from it
description: Feedback 2026-10-09T12:48:02-07:00: 'the tasks system is half-baked. No way to list tasks'. CLI has 'task ls [--all]' but the launcher only has start/switch (pick), today and stop. Add a 'Tasks' view listing every task with status/project and actions (start, done, reopen, rename, delete).

title: Can't paste (⌘V) into the Add Quicklink form fields
description: Feedback 2026-10-09T12:54:02-07:00 (Brave). panel performKeyEquivalent leaves ⌘C/⌘V/⌘A to super (platform/panel/mod.rs:82,172), but Flick sets no main menu, so for an accessory app nothing routes paste: to the field editor. Check search field too; likely fix: route cmd+x/c/v/a/z to the first responder (NSApp sendAction) in performKeyEquivalent or install a hidden Edit menu. Add a test of key routing.

title: activity: launcher view shows only the app for Brave, not URLs (urls = true is set)
description: Feedback 2026-10-09T13:04:03-07:00, build 3ad6d0e, config has [activity] urls = true. Find whether URLs are not being read (Automation permission denied? platform::browser::supports Brave?) or read but not shown in the launcher's today view (report.rs carries subject.url; check view rows). Show domain/URL per browser span in the view. Related: flick-3048, flick-bd44.

title: Ship a complete commented example config (every table and key) users can read
description: Feedback 2026-10-09T13:05:35-07:00. DEFAULT_CONFIG (src/config.rs) is written only when no config exists and does not list every option (no clipboard/apps/rebuild/windows tables?); users with a managed config (home-manager) never see it. Add config.example.toml in the repo, generated from or tested against the Settings structs so it can't drift, plus 'flick config example' to print it. Mind config.rs size budget (flick-5561).

title: feedback: resolve entries (CLI + launcher action); ls hides resolved by default
description: No way to mark feedback handled. Append-only resolution lines {resolves:<entry ts>,ts,note} keep the file's crash-safety; old builds skip them as unparseable entries. 'feedback resolve <ts> [note]', 'feedback ls [--all]', Resolve action in Recent Feedback.
